description: On a runner with Docker: show works before any list exists; an ignore pattern keeps CI-style containers off the list; accept-current writes the containers present as Compose and name keys, leaving out ignored and --rm containers; add resolves a bare name and accepts explicit keys; remove takes them off; the previous file is kept as .prev; show reports a stopped and a missing expected container. Bad input is refused with exit 2 before anything is written. Confirm reviewed records the review with a note, refuses when no list exists, and Show reports the review state and stopped containers the list does not protect. A container whose Compose project label carries a forged row is shown as UNREADABLE by name and short id, left off by Accept current and refused by Add; the label never reaches the output or the list. When docker ps fails but docker info answers (a shim on PATH), Accept current and Add by bare name exit 3 and the list is unchanged, and Show says there is no comparison without changing the exit code. Accept current with no containers will not empty a non-empty list. Show's STOPPED, UNLISTED line follows the prune: before review it says nothing is removed until then; after review a container the prune has recorded in /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal is WAITING, with when it was recorded and from when it can be removed (GRACE_HOURS from the prune's settings), and one it has not is not yet recorded; a line of that file that is not well formed is not trusted. When docker info fails, Show says there is no comparison, Accept current and Add by bare name exit 3 with the list byte-for-byte unchanged, Remove takes a bare name as name:<name>, and no docker command but docker info is run. With docker only in /snap/bin, outside the harness PATH, it is found through the appended system directories. With docker.service stopped while docker.socket listens (a shim on PATH records every docker command): Show prints the lists and the review state and says Docker was left stopped; Accept current and Add with a bare name exit 3 and change nothing; Add with keys, Remove, Add ignore, Remove ignore and Confirm reviewed work; no run starts Docker or runs any docker command. Version 6: the first step reads the script itself (the pending-removal file is read with the shared tc_pending_lines, and the tc-docker running block says it is identical in every tc-docker component); and Show gives what version 5 gave for a pending-removal file with a blank line, a second line for the same container (the first is used) and a line with CRLF endings (not trusted).

steps.label: Shared code: the pending-removal file is read with tc_pending_lines, the function the prune and the monitor share, and no parser of this component's own is left; the tc-docker running block's first line says it is identical in every tc-docker component
steps.run: f=Scripts/docker-update-expected-containers-lin/docker-update-expected-containers-lin.sh; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "cannot find $f from $(pwd)"; exit 1; }; echo "tc_pending_lines: $(grep -c '^tc_pending_lines() {$' $f) defined, $(grep -cF 'pending="$(tc_pending_lines "$PENDING_FILE")"' $f) called"; echo "parsers of its own: $(grep -c '^pending_records() {$' $f)"; echo "running block first line: $(grep -c '^# >>> tc-docker running: identical in every tc-docker component; change them together\.$' $f)"

steps.label: Four containers: plain, Compose, CI-style, --rm
steps.run: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/bin; cp /bin/sleep $d/bin/; for l in $(ldd /bin/sleep | grep -oE '/[^ ]+'); do mkdir -p $d$(dirname $l); cp $l $d$l; done; tar -C $d -c . | docker import - tc-test-sleep:1; docker run -d --name tc-a tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600; docker run -d --name tcshop-web-1 --label com.docker.compose.project=tcshop --label com.docker.compose.service=web tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600; docker run -d --name tc-runner-x tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600; docker run -d --rm --name tc-temp tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}'

steps.run:
set -e; docker create --name tc-old2 tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 1 >/dev/null; mkdir -p /etc/default /var/lib/tc-docker; chmod 700 /var/lib/tc-docker; printf '%s
' 'OLDER_THAN_HOURS=168' 'GRACE_HOURS=144' 'PRUNE_IMAGES=dangling' > /etc/default/tc-docker-prune; printf '%s
' '# Stopped containers that tc-docker-prune will remove. Written by the prune; do not edit.' > /var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; printf '%s	name:tc-old	tc-old	1795176000

STOPPED, UNLISTED  name:tc-old2  - not yet recorded for removal: the prune records it once it has been stopped 168h, then removes it 144h later; Add it to keep it

steps.label: Show after review: the pending-removal file written again with a blank line, tc-old twice (2026-11-20 12:00 UTC, then a day later) and tc-old2's line with CRLF line endings
steps.run:
set -e; f=/var/lib/tc-docker/pending-removal; o=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' tc-old); printf '%s
' '# Stopped containers that tc-docker-prune will remove. Written by the prune; do not edit.' '' > $f; printf '%s	name:tc-old	tc-old	1795176000
' $o >> $f; printf '%s	name:tc-old	tc-old	1795262400
' $o >> $f; printf '%s	name:tc-old2	tc-old2	1795176000
' $(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' tc-old2) >> $f; echo "lines: $(wc -l < $f), ending in CR: $(grep -c $'$' $f)"

steps.label: Failing Docker: record the list, then put a docker shim that fails docker ps on PATH
steps.run: sha256sum /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers > /tmp/tc-ec.sha; real=$(command -v docker); test "$real" != /usr/local/sbin/docker || exit 1; printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' '# tc-test shim: Docker answers everything except docker ps' '[ "$1" = ps ] && { echo "Error response from daemon: tc-test simulated failure" >&2; exit 1; }' "exec $real \"\$@\"" > /usr/local/sbin/docker; chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/docker; hash -r; docker ps; echo "docker ps exit $?"; docker info --format 'docker info still answers: {{.ServerVersion}}'

steps.label: Docker not answering: record the list, then put a docker shim on PATH that records every docker command and fails docker info (a daemon that is not there)
steps.run: set -e; sha256sum /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers > /var/tmp/tc-ec.sha; real=$(command -v docker); test "$real" != /usr/local/sbin/docker; printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' '# tc-test shim: records every docker command; docker info fails' 'echo "$*" >> /var/tmp/tc-docker-calls' '[ "$1" = info ] && { echo "Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at unix:///var/run/docker.sock. Is the docker daemon running?" >&2; exit 1; }' "exec $real \"\$@\"" > /usr/local/sbin/docker; chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/docker; hash -r; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "docker info exit $?"; : > /var/tmp/tc-docker-calls; echo ready

steps.label: PATH: the docker client moved to /snap/bin, which the harness PATH does not reach and the component's appended PATH does
steps.run: set -e; real=$(command -v docker); test "$real" != /usr/local/sbin/docker; test ! -e /snap/bin/docker; echo "$real" > /var/tmp/tc-docker-real; for d in /snap /snap/bin; do [ -d "$d" ] || echo "$d"; done > /var/tmp/tc-snap-made; mkdir -p /snap/bin; mv "$real" /snap/bin/docker; hash -r; env -i PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin /bin/bash -c 'command -v docker || echo "not on the harness PATH"'

steps.label: Docker only on the appended PATH: found, and Show compares as usual
PATH: the client put back where it was
steps.run: set -e; mv /snap/bin/docker "$(cat /var/tmp/tc-docker-real)"; tac /var/tmp/tc-snap-made | xargs -r rmdir; rm -f /var/tmp/tc-docker-real /var/tmp/tc-snap-made; hash -r; docker ps >/dev/null && echo "docker is back at $(command -v docker)"

steps.run: set -e; real=$(command -v docker); test "$real" != /usr/local/sbin/docker; printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' '# tc-test shim: records every docker command' 'echo "$*" >> /var/tmp/tc-docker-calls' "exec $real \"\$@\"" > /usr/local/sbin/docker; chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/docker; hash -r; : > /var/tmp/tc-docker-calls; echo "before: $(systemctl is-active docker.service docker.socket | paste -sd' ')"; systemctl stop docker.service 2>/dev/null; echo "stopped: $(systemctl is-active docker.service docker.socket | paste -sd' ')"; sha256sum /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers > /var/tmp/tc-ec.sha; grep -v '^#' /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers | sort > /var/tmp/tc-ec.entries; test -s /etc/tc-docker/reviewed && echo 'reviewed: yes'; echo "docker commands run: $(wc -l < /var/tmp/tc-docker-calls)"
